source_reviews.reviewed: manual text pages 1-5; trading logic pages 1-3
source_reviews.finding: Volatility-breakout approach uses recent Squeeze, not an unconditional outer-band fade. The manual specifies a 125-period BandWidth low, a 3-percent buffer and a five-period recent-Squeeze alert lookback. They must not be confused with generic ATR compression or a zero-buffer implementation.

source_reviews.reviewed: manual text pages 1-5; trading logic pages 1-3
source_reviews.finding: Trend-following method confirms price strength or weakness using Money Flow Index, rather than buying every lower-band touch. The manual describes MFI14 and normalized ten-period Money Flow; it does not disclose every executable trigger threshold or a complete exit/fill contract.

source_reviews.reviewed: manual text pages 1-5; trading logic pages 1-3
source_reviews.finding: Reversal alerts combine a band tag with oppositely informative Intraday Intensity. The author asks for subsequent price confirmation before a trade; a tag is not a filled order. Actual volume/input semantics and an explicit strong-bar definition remain necessary.

source_reviews.reviewed: manual text pages 1-6; trading logic pages 1-3
source_reviews.finding: Confirmed-breakout method uses recent Squeeze, two successive outside closes and ADX to distinguish trend continuation from reversal. ADX threshold changes meaning, not merely confidence. The printed text does not supply its numeric default, so a chosen threshold would be a lab hypothesis.
